designSystem.note: Ignores below are decisions, not oversights. Each one has a reason and a reviewer.

marketing-buzzword.reason: The site quotes the CV's own language (RPO/RTO targets for mission-critical Splunk, ARC certification). That wording is verified against career-ops/cv.md and must not drift. Currently zero hits on the live site; the rule is retained so a future edit cannot soften a verified CV phrase into a marketing adjective.

hero-eyebrow-chip.reason: The mono uppercase eyebrow is a binding product decision, not decoration. It replaces editorial section numbers and carries real information in one of three forms: a count on an index page ('11 projects', '6 credentials'), a category on a detail page ('Infrastructure', 'Security Tooling'), or the positioning statement on the homepage ('Infrastructure Engineer -> Software & AI Engineering'). Eyebrows that merely restate their own h1 were removed rather than ignored.
hero-eyebrow-chip.reviewer: ankit-portfolio-builder skill, Conventions: Eyebrows carry information

overused-font.reason: Geist + Geist Mono is the binding typographic identity of this site. Vercel's system, chosen deliberately. Changing the typeface is a rebrand, not a fix, and requires Ankit's explicit sign-off.
overused-font.reviewer: ankit-portfolio-builder skill, Conventions: Premium typographic aesthetic is binding
